text:
The corrupted element is **Mq1**. Its gate is tied to `sp0`, the source node of stage-0's current source, instead of the `pc` bias line. The other stages' current sources (Mq0, Mq2) and all sizes match the bias mirror (Mb2/Mb1), so the wrong gate connection is the only inconsistency. With its gate near the supply, Mq1 barely conducts, so stage 1 cannot pull up. The ring stops, which explains the ~6.7 mV swing and missing oscillation.

```json
{"ranking": ["Mq1", "Mq0", "Mq2"], "fault": "Wrong gate connection on Mq1: gate tied to sp0 (source of Mq0) instead of the pc bias node, so the stage-1 PMOS current source is effectively off and the ring fails to oscillate. Fix: connect Mq1 gate to pc."}
```
